findings.affected_requirement: FR-003, FR-028 and canonical ordered-set replay
findings.evidence: Replay checks only that every requested job appears in the existing manifest; a strict subset can be accepted as Replay because cardinality, reverse equality, order, and canonical initial state are not all required.
findings.correction_outcome: Add subset, superset, order and state mutation REDs; accept Replay only for the complete canonical deterministic manifest.

findings.evidence: The durable Scan commit path accepts and persists any well-shaped caller CommitFingerprint without recomputing the canonical materialization fingerprint.
findings.correction_outcome: Add a noncanonical fingerprint RED and recompute or exclusively persist the canonical Infrastructure-derived fingerprint while retaining exact replay.

findings.affected_requirement: FR-008, FR-009, SC-002 and bounded-failure plan rule
findings.evidence: Non-cancellation configured health exceptions can escape manual resume as an unclassified 500 instead of a bounded fail-closed result.
findings.correction_outcome: Add a throwing-health-probe RED; map non-cancellation failures to a classified fail-closed result while preserving cancellation and zero transition or dispatch.

summary: REVISE. Story 12.1 focused tests passed 162/162 and Web built with zero errors, but three HIGH implementation gaps remain in manifest replay equality, canonical commit fingerprint authority, and bounded recovery health failures.
